description: Configure strings & messages of your bot here

content.name: addAtToUsernames
content.description: If enabled, every username will be prefixed by an "@". Example: "scderox" -> "@scderox"

content.name: need_args
content.default: This command needs more arguments - you passed %count%, but you need to provide at least %neededCount%.
content.description: This message gets sent if there are not enough arguments specified

content.name: updated_roles
content.default: ✅ Updated roles according to your settings
content.description: This message gets sent after a user selects self-roles on a self-role-element.

content.name: added_role
content.description: This message gets sent when a user adds a role to themselves.

content.name: removed_role
content.description: This message gets sent when a user removes a role from themselves.

content.name: not_enough_permissions
content.default: Seems like you don't have enough permissions.
content.description: This message gets sent if an user don't hase enough permissions

default.title: Help
default.description: You can find every command here

content.name: disableHelpEmbedStats
content.description: If enabled, the stats-field in the Help-Embed will get hidden

content.name: disableFooterTimestamp
content.description: If enabled, the current time will not be displayed in the embed footer

content.name: putBotInfoOnLastSite
content.humanName: Hides the Bot-Info in the Help-Embed
content.description: If enabled, the Bot-Info-Section of the Help-Embed will be hidden.
